answer: The grove register is checked at draw time, meadow lists the eligible set, and ripple seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 42 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 42 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 34 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
